fields.Name: NetForum Enterprise Token
fields.Description: NetForum Enterprise (Community Brands / Abila) two-step SOAP session-token authentication. The connector POSTs a SOAP Authenticate(userName, password) envelope to BaseURL/xweb/secure/netForumXML.asmx and reads the token from AuthenticateResult; every subsequent xWeb call carries that token in a SOAP <AuthorizationToken><Token> header element — NOT HTTP Basic, and NOT an Authorization: Bearer header. BaseURL is per-tenant — required for any operation.
